annotations.title: Drug card: RxNorm, FDA label, DEA schedule, shortages

description: Drug card for a generic or brand name: RxNorm concept (RxCUI, ingredients, brands); one openFDA label (brand checked against RxNorm ingredients, else single-ingredient full prescribing info, most common route, earliest NDA/BLA) with clipped boxed warning, indications, dosing, contraindications, warnings, interactions, pregnancy, lactation, special-formulation flag, other routes, DailyMed link; DEA schedule and status (NDC data); FDA shortage and 2-year recall summaries. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

name.description: Generic or brand drug name, e.g. lipitor, metformin, Eliquis, amoxicillin clavulanate, Tylenol #3. A route or formulation word (oral, iv, liposomal) narrows the label choice.
